description: Diagnostic-only directive. Queries write_service for signal_analyser heartbeat age (currently 4h2m, stale >7200s threshold). Inspects service_health table, checks for import errors or loop crashes in recent logs, verifies write_service connectivity. Does NOT rebuild signal_analyser.py (protected file). Does NOT restart services. Outputs JSON diagnostic report with: heartbeat age, suspected cause, signal_analyser last processed timestamp from mcp_signal_scores, and recommended remediation steps. Needed because signal_analyser staleness blocks signal scoring pipeline.
